package.name: gnss_comm
package.description: Minimal ROS 2 interface package providing the gnss_comm GNSS PVT solution messages used by FAST-LIVO2-RTK. Field layout matches the original HKUST-Aerial-Robotics/gnss_comm ROS 1 messages so converted rosbags (gnss_comm/msg/GnssPVTSolnMsg) play back directly.
